## 1.3 High-Risk Warning Box
- **Dynamic SQL & SQL Injection:** Both `clsSQLSelectParser` and the Add/Edit form construct WHERE clauses and embedded SQL by string concatenation (e.g., `"SELECT * FROM tbl_IC_Category WHERE PK = " & PK`). No parameterised queries — injection risk on `PK` and user‑supplied filter text.
- **Embedded SQL in Code:** `cmdUsrHistory_Click` builds two `SELECT PK,CompleteName FROM tbl_SM_Users WHERE PK = " & rs.Fields("AddedByFK")` queries using the recordset’s field values without sanitisation — second‑order injection possible.
- **Global State Dependencies:** Relies on `CN` (global ADO Connection) and `CurrUser.USER_PK` (global user object) — hidden coupling that can cause threading and testing issues.
- **Client‑side Paging with Recordset:** Uses `clsPaging` on a client‑side ADO recordset; page boundaries are calculated mathematically but all data is fetched — performance degradation for large datasets.
- **COM/ActiveX Dependencies:** `mscomctl.ocx` (ListView in parent form) and `SMIAS.ctrlLiner` (in‑house UserControl) — must be replaced with modern UI components.

## 1.4 Executive Forensic Summary
1. **Business Mission:** Users list, search, create, edit, and delete product categories (inventory classification) using a modal Add/Edit form that stores data in `tbl_IC_Category`.
2. **Interaction Style:** Master‑detail: parent form (`frmCategories`) shows a paged ListView; double‑click or menu command opens the modal `frmCategoriesAE` for single‑record ADO edit.
3. **Critical Dependencies:** Global connection `CN`, global user `CurrUser`, `clsSQLSelectParser` for dynamic query building, `clsPaging` for list navigation, and utility functions `getIndex`, `getValueAt`, `is_empty`, `LeftSplitUF`, `RightSplitUF`, `clearText`, `HLText`, `prompt_err`.

features.title: Inventory Category Browsing and Management
features.description: Enables inventory managers to view, search, create, edit, and delete inventory categories with paged list view and column sorting.

functions.label: Load and display the first page of inventory categories (Form_Load)
functions.description: When the form opens, the system initializes the category list by loading a static, alphabetically sorted set of records with a page size of 75 items. This presents the starting view for inventory managers to begin browsing and managing categories.

functions.label: Edit the selected inventory category (mnuEdit)
functions.description: Upon choosing Edit from the context menu or double-clicking a category, the system checks that the record still exists. If it does, a modal form opens in edit mode for that category; otherwise, an alert appears and the list refreshes.

functions.label: Search inventory categories by column filter (mnuSearch)
functions.description: A search dialog opens modally, allowing the user to specify filter conditions based on the displayed column headers. The system applies the filter to the category list, showing only the matching results.

functions.label: Permanently delete a selected inventory category (mnuDelete)
functions.description: After verifying a category is selected and exists, the user confirms a deletion prompt. On confirmation, the category is physically removed from the database, the list refreshes, and a success message is shown; foreign key violations trigger a custom error notice.

functions.label: Refresh the category list from the database (mnuRefresh)
functions.description: Allows the user to reload the category list by re-executing the base query, resetting to page one. This ensures any data changes made elsewhere are immediately visible.

functions.label: Sort the category list by a selected column (lvList_ColumnClick)
functions.description: Clicking a column header toggles the sort order between ascending and descending for that column. This lets inventory managers quickly reorder categories by name, description, or key.

functions.label: Edit the selected category via double-click (lvList_DblClick)
functions.description: Double-clicking a category row initiates the same edit action as the context menu Edit option, opening the edit form for that category.

functions.label: Close the inventory category management window (Form_Unload)
functions.description: When the user closes the form, the window is deregistered from the parent application, associated toolbar buttons are hidden, and the form reference is cleaned up, returning the user to the main interface.

functions.label: Open the form to add a new inventory category (mnuNew)
functions.description: Selecting New from the context menu switches the category entry form into add mode and opens it modally. This enables the user to create a new category record.

functions.label: Go to the first page of the category list (btnFirst_Click)
functions.description: Navigates the category list to the first page if not already there, providing quick access to the beginning of the sorted list.

functions.label: Go to the previous page of categories (btnPrev_Click)
functions.description: Moves the list to the immediately preceding page unless already at the first page, supporting step-by-step backward navigation through the categories.

functions.label: Go to the next page of categories (btnNext_Click)
functions.description: Advances the list to the next page unless already at the last page, enabling forward browsing through the categorized records.

functions.label: Go to the last page of the category list (btnLast_Click)
functions.description: Jumps to the final page of categories if not already displayed, offering immediate access to the end of the sorted list.

functions.label: Update the selected category indicator during keyboard navigation (lvList_KeyUp)
functions.description: When the user navigates the list using arrow or page keys, the system refreshes the label displaying the currently highlighted category. This keeps the user informed about which record is selected for subsequent actions.

features.title: Product Catalogue Browsing and Selection
features.description: Enables users to browse the product catalogue through a paginated ListView, navigate between pages, sort by column, select a row to view the current record, double-click to open the product edit form, and use a right-click context menu for CRUD operations.

functions.label: Load and display the product catalogue (Form_Load)
functions.description: On opening the product browsing form, all products are loaded from the database and displayed in a paginated list, with the first 75 items visible immediately. This gives users instant access to browse the catalogue.

functions.label: Show the currently selected product (lvList_Click)
functions.description: Clicking a product row updates a label to display the selected product's name, clearly indicating the active record for further actions. If no row is selected, the label shows 'NONE'.

functions.label: Open the product edit form for the selected record (lvList_DblClick)
functions.description: Double-clicking a product row opens the product editing screen, allowing modification of product details. Before opening, the system verifies the record still exists; if it was deleted, the list refreshes to reflect current data.

functions.label: Sort the product list by clicked column (lvList_ColumnClick)
functions.description: Clicking a column header sorts the product list by that column. Clicking the same column again reverses the sort order, helping users quickly organize products by name, status, or other attributes. This sorting only affects the on-screen list.

functions.label: Navigate to the first page of products (btnFirst_Click)
functions.description: When the user clicks the 'First Page' button, the product list jumps to page 1, showing the initial set of 75 products. This allows quick access to the beginning of the catalogue without scrolling through pages.

functions.label: Go to the previous page of products (btnPrev_Click)
functions.description: Clicking the 'Previous Page' button loads the preceding page of products if the user is not already on the first page. This provides step-by-step backward navigation through the product catalogue.

functions.label: Advance to the next page of products (btnNext_Click)
functions.description: The 'Next Page' button loads the subsequent page of products, provided there are more pages to view. This enables forward progression through the product listings.

functions.label: Jump to the last page of products (btnLast_Click)
functions.description: Clicking the 'Last Page' button takes the user directly to the final page of the product catalogue. This is useful for quickly reaching the end of the list without paging through all entries.

functions.label: Show the product actions context menu (lvList_MouseUp)
functions.description: Right-clicking on a product row displays a menu of available actions, such as creating, editing, or deleting a product. This allows users to perform product management tasks directly from the list without navigating away.

functions.label: Close the product browsing window (Form_Unload)
functions.description: Closing the product catalogue window removes it from the application's window list and hides its toolbar button. The form closes immediately without asking to save, ensuring a quick exit from the browsing experience.

Right‑click context menu (e.g., MUI Menu) triggers the same edit navigation. Pagination controls use the API’s pageable response. Ensure all queries are parameterised to prevent SQL injection (NFR).
